blind_spots.blind_spot: All the headline numbers (92% cost savings, 97% faster updates, 18x faster Navy model redeployment) are about model-iteration speed and GPU cost — none quantify the actual SWaP-C footprint (size/weight/power draw) on the tactical hardware the model runs on in the field.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A model that updates 18x faster is worthless if the inference hardware doesn't fit the power/weight budget of the dismounted kit or Group 1-2 UAS payload it's meant to ride on; SWaP-C is the metric that decides whether this ships on the actual platform, not just in a lab benchmark.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Public stats are optimized for enterprise/commercial buyers (sports, retail, agriculture) where GPU cost dominates the pitch, and that framing carried over into the DoD messaging.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: We're helping one manufacturer reduce required GPUs by 92%.

blind_spots.blind_spot: 'Field-updatable AI' is marketed as a core strength, but nothing in the public language addresses the ATO/RMF/CMMC burden of pushing OTA model updates onto a device sitting on a classified or IL4/IL5 network.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Live over-the-air model updates are exactly the kind of capability that draws extra POA&M scrutiny in an RMF review — a feature that's a selling point in the commercial pitch becomes a compliance liability the moment FTS is on a government network, and there's no visible sign that path has been walked yet.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The APFIT award and Operation Jailbreak validation are recent (2025-2026); the compliance/ATO story likely hasn't caught up to the field-validation story in the company's public voice.

blind_spots.blind_spot: The same homepage carrying the Navy testimonial also headlines sports analytics, retail, fast food, and construction use cases — commercial dual-use messaging sits directly alongside the DoD pitch with no visible program-of-record sponsor above the Task Force 75 operator level.
blind_spots.operator_reality: An operator loving the ATR model isn't adoption; APFIT selection starts a transition clock, and a ~51-person team splitting GTM attention across seven commercial verticals plus DoD has less bandwidth to build the acquisition advocacy chain that actually converts a pilot into a program of record.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Company is still selling a horizontal edge-AI platform (LEIP) with defense as one vertical among many, rather than an org built exclusively around the DoD transition.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Real-world AI at the edge... Sports Analytics... Industrial IoT... Smart Cities... Retail & Consumer Experience... Transportation... Fast Food & Quick Service... Construction... Agriculture & Sustainability

opener_hook: Latent AI just cleared all three field-test gates in Army Operation Jailbreak on Lattice C2 and the NATO coalition stack — with APFIT funding now in hand, what's the ATO path for pushing OTA model updates once FTS sits on an IL4/IL5 network?
what_they_do: Edge-AI model-compression/deployment platform (LEIP) with a defense-specific Field Tactical Suite for off-grid, ATAK-integrated tactical AI; validated in Army Operation Jailbreak (counter-UAS/drone autonomy) and a Navy pilot, selected for DoD APFIT.
